description: Number of times a video was viewed. Additive.
Views by YouTube Premium (Red) members. Additive. Planned.
Views that passed the initial engagement threshold. Additive. Planned.
Positive ratings (likes). Additive.
Negative ratings (dislikes). Additive. Planned.
Number of comments users left. Additive.
Times shared via the Share button. Additive.
Total minutes users watched. Additive.
Average seconds watched per playback. RATIO / non-additive = estimatedMinutesWatched*60 / views -- DERIVABLE, computed at the semantic layer (AD-4), never stored raw. Planned/excluded from storage.
Average % of a video watched. RATIO / non-additive (needs video length; not derivable from views/minutes). Planned. Cannot combine with the liveOrOnDemand dimension.
Times users subscribed. Additive.
Times users unsubscribed. Additive.
Times videos added to any playlist. Additive. Planned.
Times videos removed from any playlist. Additive. Planned.
Times viewers initiated playlist playback. Additive. Planned.
Views within the playlist context. Additive. Planned.
Net playlist saves. Additive. Planned.
Minutes watched in playlist context. Additive. Planned.
Total annotation impressions. Additive. Planned.
Annotations clicked. Additive. Planned.
Clicks / clickable impressions. RATIO / non-additive. Planned.
Times cards shown. Additive. Planned.
Card clicks. Additive. Planned.
Card click-through rate. RATIO / non-additive. Planned.
Total estimated net revenue (ad + non-ad). Additive. Requires the yt-analytics-monetary.readonly scope. Planned (monetary).
Net revenue from Google-sold ads. Additive. Monetary scope. Planned.
Revenue from YouTube Premium. Additive. Monetary scope. Planned.
Estimated gross revenue (USD). Additive. Monetary scope. Planned.
Playbacks with >=1 ad impression. Additive. Monetary scope. Planned.
Verified ad impressions served. Additive. Monetary scope. Planned.
Gross revenue per 1,000 ad impressions. RATIO / non-additive. Monetary scope. Planned.
Reporting day (YYYY-MM-DD), from the 'day' dimension. Daily grain. Full lifetime history available from channel creation (complete from 2013-01-01).
Reporting month (YYYY-MM). Planned.
Video resource id (group-by + filter).
Playlist resource id (group-by + filter). Planned.

The reporting entity: YouTube channel id. Stamped on every row (ids=channel==MINE resolves to the connected channel, discovered via Data API channels.list(mine=true)). In content-owner (MCN) mode the API 'channel' dimension breaks results down by channel.
Viewer country, ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. US, FR). NOTE: alpha-2, distinct from GA4/GSC governed 'country' vocabulary -- kept as its own field, not mapped onto the governed dimension. Planned.
US state (ISO 3166-2). Planned.
Estimated city (<=250 rows). Planned.
Device form factor: DESKTOP, GAME_CONSOLE, MOBILE, TABLET, TV, UNKNOWN_PLATFORM. Planned.
Device OS (ANDROID, IOS, WINDOWS, MACINTOSH, ...). Enum documented-but-unverified; re-verify live. Planned.

How users reached the video: ADVERTISING, ANNOTATION, CAMPAIGN_CARD, END_SCREEN, EXT_URL, HASHTAGS, LIVE_REDIRECT, NO_LINK_EMBEDDED, NO_LINK_OTHER, NOTIFICATION, PLAYLIST, PRODUCT_PAGE, PROMOTED, RELATED_VIDEO, SHORTS, SOUND_PAGE, SUBSCRIBER, VIDEO_REMIXES, YT_CHANNEL, YT_OTHER_PAGE, YT_SEARCH. Planned.
Top referrers within a traffic source type. Planned.
Where playback occurred: BROWSE, CHANNEL, EMBEDDED, EXTERNAL_APP, MOBILE, SEARCH, WATCH, YT_OTHER. Planned.
Viewer age bucket: age13-17, age18-24, age25-34, age35-44, age45-54, age55-64, age65-. Suppressed below privacy thresholds. Planned.
Viewer gender: female, male, user_specified. Enum documented-but-unverified. Planned.
Subscribed vs not at view time: SUBSCRIBED, UNSUBSCRIBED. Planned.
LIVE vs ON_DEMAND. Cannot be combined with averageViewPercentage. Planned.
Service used to share a video. Planned.
Ad format that ran (auctionInstream, reservedBumperInstream, ...). Planned (monetary).
Date a video was published on the channel (snippet.publishedAt from the Data API v3 uploads playlist). Maps to canonical event_type video_upload. label = snippet.title.
